page_title: FRECKLE PEN + EYELINER DUO - BROWN | ZARA United States

jsonld_raw.name: FRECKLE PEN + EYELINER DUO
jsonld_raw.description: Liquid freckle pen and eyeliner. This 2-in-1 tool is easy to carry. The 5-point tip varies slightly in height and thickness, allowing you to create highly realistic freckles in various sizes and colors. The freckle cushion applies makeup quickly for a more natural-looking finish. The eyeliner features an ultra-precise, fine tip that ensures flawless control and definition during application. Its brown formula glides on smoothly, creating defined lines with ease and a natural look.
